description_en: Retrieves the download URLs of raw access logs for a specified domain name in ApsaraVideo Live
description_zh: 获取直播指定域名的原始访问日志的下载地址
kebab_example: aliyun live describe-live-domain-log --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --page-size 20 --page-number 1 --start-time 2016-10-20T04:00:00Z --end-time 2016-10-20T05:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLiveDomainLog

parameters.description_en:
The streaming domain or ingest domain.
> - When you specify DomainName, make sure that the domain name is a live streaming domain name and that the user calling this operation has the required permissions on the specified domain name.
> - Only a single domain name can be queried at a time.
parameters.description_zh:
播流域名或推流域名。
> - 传入DomainName时，请保证传入域名为直播域名，同时调用本接口的用户拥有传入域名的操作权限。
> - 只支持单个域名查询。
